assessment: These ingenious and thoughtful studies present important findings concerning how people can represent and generalise abstract patterns of sensory data. The issue of generalization is a core topic in neuroscience and psychology, relevant across a wide range of areas, and the findings will be of interest to researchers across areas in perception, learning and cognitive science. The findings are convincing in this setting, but future research must establish their generality and interrogate the precise nature of the underlying mechanism.
